notes.title: Pre-functional update! | Closed alpha 0.6
notes.content:
[h1][b]Fixes:[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Fixed bug in ESC menu with continue button[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed double-click bug in UI menu[/p][/*][*][p]Removed blur on camera and noise[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Minor changes: [/b][/h1][list][*][p]Removed the initial training widget[/p][/*][*][p]Changed button in the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added objects to the lab on Level 0[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Q\\E turns of the character[/p][/*][*][p]Daryl now does not return to his original position[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Minor additions: [/b][/h1][list][*][p]Added camera lift catcall scene on Level 1[/p][/*][*][p]Slides on Level 37 now do not lead into walls[/p][/*][*][p]Added empty room on Level 1[/p][/*][*][p]Added objects to the lab locker room on Level 0[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly optimized lab on Level 0[/p][/*][*][p]Added transition between Level 4 and Level 2[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the beginning of Level 1[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Major changes: [/b][/h1][list][*][p]Added Level 4[/p][/*][*][p]Added Level 33[/p][/*][*][p]Added locked doors[/p][/*][*][p]Updated elevator[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]In the next update we will emphasize the functionality of the levels, add more interactions, events, etc.

This update was needed more for us, we have changed the architecture of folders in the project, removed unused assets, made the correct names for all objects involved in the development of the
game, now it is much easier to work ![/p][p]
We will try to do our best while we have free time ![/p][p]
Thank you very much for following us, more to come ! [/p][p]Top 1 game on the backrooms is getting closer and closer ![/p]

notes.title: Close-Aplha 0.2 update
notes.content:
As soon as the first trial version of the closed-alpha version of the game was released, you could find quite a large number of bugs that we missed during the development of the game.

We promptly tried to solve most of them, there is a list of changed ones below:

[list]
[*] Doors in the lab on level 0 now have collision
[*] Added description of each map in the main menu
[*] Prohibited character movement during the initial cutscene on level 1
[*] Removed lockers on level 2 that were obstructing the walkway
[*] Added 2 sounds in the cutscene on level 0
[*] Slightly changed main menu
[*] Reduced camera movement speed in the main menu
[*] Added collisions on level 2
[*] Removed line trace (red bars that appear when you press E).
[*] Changed level 37
[/list]

Thank you for helping us find bugs so quickly, we really appreciate your willingness to help in the development of the project !
